reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is guarded by a regex validation against a servlet init parameter ('file.pattern'). While this acts as a mitigation, the actual regex pattern is determined at deployment time and is not visible in the source code. Consequently, it is unclear whether the pattern sufficiently restricts characters (e.g., preventing '../') to stop path traversal. Following the border-line calibration for non-visible mitigations, this is classified as alert-unclear.
